description:
A quote for an exchange and the link to make it on the site.

        `give` and `receive` are method codes; `amount` is what the client gives
        (amount_side="give") or wants to receive (amount_side="receive"). Returns
        both amounts, the rate, the limits, the requisites the site will ask for
        and `exchange_link`: the site's exchange form with all this filled in,
        where the person enters the e-mail and requisites and creates the bid.
name: get_quote
